revisions.reason: Kit audit: side-to-move perspective made explicit; C1 became a two-stage design with a pre-registered epsilon rule; C2's primary metric became cross-band uplift with game-clustered bootstrap and a post-release date window; C3 gained greedy and oracle policies, a game-sized observation model and gap closure as the headline; entropy thresholds moved to configs/default.yaml (runtime). Design-stage C3 simulations used seeds 0 to 2; confirmatory runs use seeds.global.

Approved by the human before any C1 game: C1.learner_profile fixes the learner policy pi_L behind Sensei's choices in C1 to the HumanSL profile rank_10k, the app's default declared rank. v2 left it unspecified.

details.metric: cross-band uplift U = mean over k of P_{k+1}(played = s_k) - P_k(played = s_k)
details.success_rule: lower end of the 95% CI of U > 0

definitions.s_k: Sensei's choice at epsilon* with band k's HumanSL profile as the learner policy
definitions.b: the reliable candidate with the highest value (ties: more visits)
definitions.r: a uniformly random admissible move, seeded per position
